content: Hi, what is your shipping time and return policy?

Namaste! We offer free shipping on orders above INR 1,999, and delivery typically takes 3-5 business days. We also have a 7-day return policy for all unworn garments with original tags intact. Are you shopping for a specific occasion today?
No, just checking details before ordering the Chanderi Silk Suit Set.

Ah! The Chanderi Silk Suit Set (SKU-SUIT-002) is a beautiful green traditional suit set, priced at INR 4,200. It is in stock and qualifies for free shipping! Let me know if you would like to select a size.
My pleasure! Let me know when you are ready to order. Happy shopping!
